statuses.BLOCKED_NETWORK: source host unreachable from this environment (proxy) or refused by the origin; not evaded
statuses.BLOCKED_NO_FREE_PIT_SOURCE: no free source gives the value as known before the game; prospective capture would be needed
statuses.PARTIAL_EVIDENCE: raw data acquirable but a dependency keeps the input from PIT completeness
statuses.VERIFIED_ACQUIRABLE: real sample fetched, fields and fill measured, point-in-time behaviour stated, history depth measured; rights tier stated separately (acquirable != rights-cleared != built)
